gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ar-one-sans: Bold display letters with wide gaps in the e lead the way. AR One Sans takes over below with lifted, brush-like ends on its curves, so a longer passage feels modern and loosely drawn rather than stiff.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-assistant: Happy Monkey draws every stroke at a single thickness, bold and unmistakable in its display shapes. Assistant brings mouths that stay open on c, e and a, and that openness is the strongest thing the sans offers.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-asta-sans: Approachable from the start, with a heading that is hard to ignore. Happy Monkey is best at bold, ruler-straight display shapes, while Asta Sans does its work in tubelike, constant-weight lines whose e never clogs into a blot.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bai-jamjuree: Wide gaps inside the e and a ruler-straight line give Happy Monkey its bold, distinctive look up top. Happy Monkey grabs attention, while Bai Jamjuree quietly carries the text with light round letters.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-barlow: Happy Monkey leads with bold, distinctive display letters and a ruler-straight line weight. Barlow, the sans-serif partner, matches that straightness with neon-tube strokes and c shapes pulled well apart, which is what ties them together.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads modern and businesslike, with a wide channel into every bowl. Happy Monkey stays loud above it with no brush-like swelling, so the body text can sit comfortably a touch larger than you might expect.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-biz-udpgothic: Thin hairline joins are swapped for full-width stroke connections in Happy Monkey, which gives it a bold, blocky confidence. BIZ UDPGothic follows with lavish letter spacing and clear channels into round letters, so a slightly smaller size still reads well.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bpmf-huninn: Loud, chunky and ruler-straight. Happy Monkey earns its keep big and short, while Bpmf Huninn keeps a modern single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl for the running text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std reads in a friendly, approachable way, with counters that stay connected to the outside. Happy Monkey needs no hairlines, while the body shows a restrained swell in its curves, so it holds up at modest sizes.
